title: Investing & Trading
description: Retail broking apps — a second domain that shows the engine generalises.

themes.name: Onboarding & KYC
themes.definition: Account opening, KYC/e-sign, bank or demat linking, login and OTP issues at signup.

themes.name: Order & trade failures
themes.definition: Orders rejected or delayed, wrong execution price, app unavailable during market hours, withdrawals/fund transfers failing or slow.

themes.name: Customer support
themes.definition: Unresponsive or unhelpful support, no human agent, unresolved tickets.

themes.name: Fees & brokerage
themes.definition: Brokerage, hidden charges, AMC, DP charges, margin or pricing complaints and comparisons.

themes.name: Trust & security
themes.definition: Fraud, account freezes, unauthorised actions, data privacy, fears about safety of funds.

themes.name: App performance & UX
themes.definition: Crashes, lag, bugs, charts/data delays, confusing design, updates that broke things.

themes.name: Product & features
themes.definition: Requests for missing features or praise/complaints about product offerings (MF, IPO, F&O, charts, alerts) without a specific problem above.

themes.name: Other / unclear
themes.definition: Too short, spam, off-topic, or fits none of the above.
